# storage
---

<!-- Generated by docs/5-reference/generate.py from the doc comments: do not edit. -->

Package storage opens MUSA's database: one SQLite file on the device, with the tables of every feature. Features write their own queries; this package only gives them the connection, the schema and transactions.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `const InMemory = ":memory:"` | InMemory is the path that opens a database living only in memory, for tests and the demo. |
| `func Milliseconds(moment time.Time) int64` | Milliseconds is how a moment is stored: Unix milliseconds. |
| `func Moment(milliseconds int64) time.Time` | Moment reads back a stored moment. |
| `func NewID() string` | NewID makes a random UUID ("3f2b…-…"). |
| `type Code string` | Code is a stable name for what went wrong, for programs to check and people to search for. |
| `const CodeOpenFailed Code = "storage.open-failed" ...` | Error codes of this package. |
| `type Database struct{ ... }` | Database is an open MUSA database. |
| `func Open(path string) (*Database, error)` | Open opens the database file at path, making it and its tables when missing and bringing an older one up to date. |
| `type Error struct{ ... }` | Error is a storage failure: its code, and what lay underneath. |
| `type Querier interface{ ... }` | Querier is what reads and writes rows: the database itself or a transaction in progress. |
